short_description: A three-hour immersive limo tour tracing Elizabeth Short’s final days and key Los Angeles locations connected to the Black Dahlia case.
cancellation_summary: Tours may be canceled for low bookings; late arrivals are not refunded or rescheduled; refundable only in some cancellation/reschedule scenarios per operator policy.
location_address: 6801 Hollywood Boulevard Los Angeles, CA US 90028
accessibility: Vehicles are older limousines and may not meet modern accessibility standards; limited space for mobility devices.
description: Step into a noir‑tinged memorial as you ride in a vintage funeral limo through Hollywood and South Los Angeles, following the last known footsteps of Elizabeth Short. The guide layers archival research, atmospheric storytelling, visuals, and a curated soundtrack to examine the woman behind the Black Dahlia myth—her residences, haunts, medical history, suspects, and the discovery site of her body. This immersive three‑hour tour blends true‑crime investigation, cultural history, and evocative scenes of postwar Los Angeles to reframe a notorious cold case.

what_is_included_items.value: Tour of Elizabeth Short’s final days and sightings in Los Angeles
Access to visual gallery for mourners with cell phone data services

itinerary:
1. Chancellor Apartments - Outside view of Room 501 and discussion of Short’s life there.
2. Pig'n'Whistle - Sidewalk stop to place Short in Hollywood’s café scene.
3. Boardners - Outside visit and stories of its noir-era patrons.
4. Hollywood Cherokee building - Stop outside the gynecologist’s former office and related background.
5. Hollywood Blvd - Funeral limo drive along Hollywood Boulevard with narrative of the area.
6. The Frolic Room - Sidewalk stop examining its connection to Dahlia-era nightlife.
7. Florentine Gardens - Stop discussing suspect connections and alleged encounters.
8. Guardian Arms - Outside stop covering a short stay tied to suspect Margolis.
9. Sowden (Hodel) House - Street-level viewing and discussion of allegations against Hodel.
10. Biltmore Hotel - Stop covering the last known sightings and conflicting accounts.
11. The Crown Bar - Near former nightclub site and its role in timelines.
12. Hotel Cecil - Outside stop linking the hotel to broader true crime legends.
13. Herald Examiner Building - Discussion of media sensationalism and leaked details.
14. Catalina St bungalow - Stop covering theories tying the bungalow to the murder.
15. Coffee and restroom break
16. Walter Bayley residence - Stop about another suspect’s former home.
17. Body discovery location - Site visit to the lot where Short’s body was found.
18. Store on Crenshaw - Stop where personal items were reportedly found.
19. AHS Murder (Rosenheim) House - Outside view and discussion of pop‑culture links.
highlights:
* Ride in a vintage funeral limo for an immersive, atmospheric experience
* Visit the actual streets, hotels, and buildings tied to the Black Dahlia case
* Archival visuals, curated soundtrack, and researched storytelling
* Expert guide reframes myth and focuses on Elizabeth Short’s humanity
check_in_details: Meet at Ovation Hollywood (6801 Hollywood Blvd). A mortuary associate will welcome guests 20 minutes before seating; arrive at the meeting point 15–20 minutes before departure. Late arrivals cannot join once the tour begins.

what_to_bring_items.value: Valid ID for minors accompanied by a guardian if requested
Comfortable clothing suitable for sitting in a limousine

special_requirements: Tour contains explicit and potentially disturbing content; not recommended for children under 12. Minors under 18 must be accompanied by a parent or legal guardian.
restrictions: No luggage or strollers allowed (vehicles accommodate passengers only). No eating, smoking, or drinking on tours (bottled water with caps permitted). Pets and infants under 5 are strictly prohibited.
disclaimers: Tours may be canceled for low bookings. Tours operate in most weather unless safety is at risk and will depart on schedule; late arrivals are not refunded or rescheduled. Food and drink (except capped bottled water) are prohibited. Some tour content is explicit and graphic; attendees under 18 must have parental permission. Vehicles are older limousines and may have wear‑related issues; the operator is not liable for most damages or delays beyond its control. If a vehicle breakdown occurs, the operator will return passengers to the departure point and issue a full refund of ticket cost only. Passenger size/weight constraints may require rescheduling or refunds for some guests. Disruptive riders may be removed without refund.
